mainEntity.name: How long does Paraguay residency take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The full process takes 8-12 weeks from document preparation to receiving your cédula (ID card).

mainEntity.name: How much does Paraguay residency cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Nexa's Paraguay Base program starts at USD 2,900. The Paraguay Business program is USD 4,400+, and the Investor Program is USD 6,900+.
No. Paraguay has a territorial tax system. Foreign-source income is taxed at 0%. Only Paraguay-source income is taxed at 10%.

mainEntity.name: Do I need to live in Paraguay full-time?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. For permanent residency, you only need to visit Paraguay once every 3 years. There is no minimum number of days required per visit.

mainEntity.name: How long to get Paraguayan citizenship?

acceptedAnswer.text: Citizenship is available after 3 years of residency. This is one of the fastest citizenship paths in the western hemisphere.

mainEntity.name: Do I need to invest money to get Paraguay residency?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. The standard residency route has no minimum investment or income requirement. The Investor Pass ($150K-$200K) is optional.

mainEntity.name: Does Paraguay have a digital nomad visa?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, but that's actually better. Paraguay offers permanent residency with 0% foreign income tax, no income threshold, and citizenship in 3 years — far superior to any temporary digital nomad visa.

mainEntity.name: Can I work in Paraguay as a foreigner?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. With a RUC (tax registration) you can work legally in Paraguay. Remote work for foreign clients is taxed at 0%.

mainEntity.name: Is there a wealth tax in Paraguay?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Paraguay has no wealth tax, no inheritance tax, and no capital gains tax on foreign assets.

mainEntity.name: How is Paraguay different from Uruguay for tax residency?

acceptedAnswer.text: Uruguay's 2026 tax reform now taxes foreign income at 12%. Their tax holiday requires $2M in real estate. Paraguay offers 0% permanently with no investment.
